LAKSHYA ENGINEERING & CONSTRUCTION 
 
 Office of the Executive Engineer · West Bengal · IN 
 
 No. CC/49/2021/030 
 Dated: 31/03/2026 
 
 CERTIFICATE OF COMPLETION OF WORK 
 This is to certify that the work of "WTP Augmentation - West Bengal Pkg-30"
 
 (water treatment), awarded to M/s National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. (GSTIN
 19NAICC4417O1Z1, PAN NAICC4417O) , has been completed in all respects on 
 28/06/2021 at a gross executed value of Rs. 18.26 Crore (Rupees 18.26 Crore
 Only). 
 The work has been completed in all respects as per the approved drawings,
 specifications, and contract conditions. The quality of work has been found
 satisfactory during the final inspection carried out by the undersigned. 
 
 The work was supervised on the contractor's side by Neha Chopra. This 
 certificate is issued for record and for submission with future tenders wherever
 the contractor is required to establish past performance. 
 
 
 
 Executive Engineer 
 Lakshya Engineering & Construction
